notes: These documents are reviewable candidate persona_memory rows for persona_id=dba_auditor.
They should be upserted only after approval because they encode process memory, not source-canon story memory.
Use the memory daemon /upsert endpoint with collection=persona_memory and the parsed JSONL documents.
example_command:
python - <<'PY'
import json, httpx
path='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/agents/dba-auditor/memory-upsert-candidates.jsonl'
docs=[json.loads(line) for line in open(path, encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
r=httpx.post('http://127.0.0.1:8601/upsert', json={'collection':'persona_memory','documents':docs}, timeout=60)
print(r.status_code)
print(r.text[:2000])
PY
